title: Witchcraft for Wayward Girls
author: Grady Hendrix
summary: In 1970s Florida, pregnant teenagers are sent to a home for unwed mothers where they are shamed and controlled. A girl finds a book on witchcraft in the library and begins to wonder if it can help.
readIf: you like horror grounded in real social cruelty, with a feminist edge.
skipIf: you want to avoid pregnancy, coercion and trauma content.
